name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
amount: Full cost: fees, maintenance, flights, visa
dlText: 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027, 23:59 UK (set by your course)
tags: Tick Gates box in Cambridge application
note: About 70 full-cost scholarships a year. Your course's funding deadline decides which date applies. Notifications by 8 March 2027.

name: Clarendon Scholarship
amount: Fees plus living grant at UKRI rate
dlText: Course deadline, Dec 2026 or Jan 2027, 12:00 UK (MSc Advanced CS: 6 Jan)
note: More than 200 awards a year. Apply to your Oxford course by its December or January deadline; March deadlines don't qualify.

name: Chevening Scholarship

eligibility.note: Only citizens of Chevening-eligible countries (about 160, incl. Pakistan); check the country list

note: One-year UK master's. Four 300-word essays; 2027/28 interviews Mar–Apr 2027, results from mid-June.

name: Commonwealth Master's & PhD Scholarships
host: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
dlText: Closed 20 Oct 2026 (CSC portal 16:00 BST; national agencies set earlier dates)
tags: Must reside in an eligible country

eligibility.note: Only citizens of the 43 low- and middle-income Commonwealth countries on the CSC list for 2027/28 (incl. Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa)

nominationBody: Your national nominating agency (e.g. HEC in Pakistan) or an approved university/NGO nominator

countryNotes.PK: Nominated by HEC: the HEC portal closed 20 Oct 2026, 16:00 PKT. HAT score ≥ 60 and a first division in a 16-year bachelor's are required; HEC had 26 master's and 30 PhD nominations. Dual nationals ineligible.

note: Taught master's (no MBA) and PhD in the UK. You apply on the CSC portal and through a national nominating agency, which has its own (earlier) deadline and rules.

name: Rhodes Scholarship
dlText: Set by constituency (country/region); most close Jul – Oct · Pakistan closed 5 Aug 2026

countryNotes.PK: Pakistan constituency: two scholarships a year, 1 Jun – 5 Aug (23:59 PKT), no fee. You must have studied in Pakistan for at least 4 of the last 10 years and finished school in Pakistan.

note: Each constituency (country or region) has its own deadline and residency rules; applicants from countries without one can apply for the Global Rhodes Scholarships. Fully funded study at Oxford.

name: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
amount: Tuition, living allowance, flights (check official page)
dlText: 10 Nov – 8 Dec 2026, 16:00 GMT (also apply to the university course)
tags: No year+ in a high-income country
fields: Development-relevant one-year master's at participating UK universities
note: About 180 awards for 2027/28. You must be a citizen (or refugee) and permanent resident of an eligible country. Cameroonian citizens can't currently get a UK student visa.

name: GREAT Scholarships (UK)
dlText: Each participating university sets its own deadline (e.g. Edinburgh's 2026-27 deadline was 1 May 2026)
tags: Passport + permanent residence in an eligible country
note: Countries are from the 2027 call. Universities pick their scholars by 30 Jun 2027.
